ios.desc:
Learn English the way people actually speak it.

English With Lewis is the English app for adults who want real progress, not another game. No childish cartoons, no endless points, no hearts to lose. Just practical English you can use in a meeting, on a trip, or down the pub, taught by Lewis, a native British teacher followed by over a million learners.

Powered by AI, built around you:

• Talk to Lewis anytime. Natural AI conversations that adapt to your level and reply like a real person.
• Role-play real situations. Job interviews, ordering coffee, first dates, the airport and more.
• Train your pronunciation. Record yourself, get instant feedback, and finally sound natural.
• Build your own word bank. Save any word, see it explained with examples, review it your way.
• Smart flashcards. Lock in vocabulary with spaced repetition that targets what you forget.
• Daily quests and streaks. Stay consistent without the mindless grind.
• A live leaderboard. Climb the ranks against learners worldwide and in your own language.

Whether you are preparing for travel, work, an exam, or simply want the confidence to speak, English With Lewis gives you the tools to sound natural and be understood.

If you are tired of apps that keep you stuck at the same level, this is the one that finally moves you forward.

Download free and start today.
